title: Dining Plan Ranks, Minimum Plan and Household Terms
content:
Each plan of the Dining Plan has a rank, from 1 for the smallest plan to 6 for the largest, and the eligibility terms that govern who may hold which plan are stated against those ranks.

## Plan ranks

| Rank | Plan |
|---|---|
| 1 | Dining 10 Meal Plan |
| 2 | Dining 15 Meal Plan |
| 3 | Dining 30 Meal Plan |
| 4 | Dining 45 Meal Plan |
| 5 | Dining 60 Meal Plan |
| 6 | Dining Full Board Plan |

## Eligibility and household terms by plan

| Plan | Lowest plan rank an independent living resident of a non-cottage apartment must hold | Independent Living Cottage Home residents exempt from the minimum plan | Assisted living or memory care residents may hold a dining plan | Both occupants of a double-occupancy apartment redeem from one plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 2 | Yes | No | Yes |

## Reading the ranks against the minimum

| Plan | Rank | At or above the minimum rank of 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 1 | No |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 2 | Yes (equal to the minimum) |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 3 | Yes |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 4 | Yes |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 5 | Yes |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 6 | Yes |

The minimum is a lowest rank, so a plan whose rank equals 2 meets it. The cottage exemption concerns residents of the Independent Living Cottage Home apartment type only.
